notes.notes:
[p]Today’s update deals with performance, reducing GPU usage to less than half what it was before in many cases. We deliver a balance overhaul with a couple of item redesigns, though mostly small changes. We’ve integrated Steam Authentication, improving the security, and therefore competitive integrity, of the game. And finally, of course, many bug fixes.[/p][p][/p][p][u]Bug Fixes[/u][/p][list][*][p]Fixed Troubling sometimes appearing in the Shop[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed tooltip for Rebels Repository Plans not showing [u]Balance Notes[/u]

Eating things is fun![/p][p]Devour can feel overpowered as a mechanic. This is primarily a problem with Baron Harkonion, so he’s been redesigned. We’ve also made some other small adjustments to Devour-based cargo.
[/p][p][b]Baron Harkonion[/b][/p][p]Old[/p][p]Pilot Slot: 
On Battle Start: Devours itself.
On Devoured: This Spaceship permanently gains “On Attack: Gain 10 Shield.” Baron Harkonion respawns in your reserve.[/p][p]New[/p][p]Pilot Slot: 
On Battle Start: Devours itself.
On Devoured: This Spaceship permanently gains “On Attack: Gain 10 Shield.” Create 2 random Common Crew in your reserve.[/p][p][/p][p]That should bring Devour mostly in-line, though the following cargo will also be slightly revised:[/p][p]

notes.title: Konfronto — The Road to 1.0
notes.notes:
[p]As we get ready to leave Early Access, we wanted to share the current roadmap with you. Thank you for playing Konfronto with us in Early Access, and thank you for all your feedback. You’ve helped the team shape Konfronto into a game worthy of the hundreds of hours some of you have put in already.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Release 0.7 - Coming very, very soon[/b][/p][p]“I hav’nae got the GPU power, cap’n” [/p][p]This one is mostly about performance fixes (sorry for cooking your GPU), but it also includes Steam Authentication integration, an important step in maintaining the integrity of the competitive experience. There are quite a few bug fixes, and importantly some balance changes. We will detail the balance changes in the patch notes, and they can also be found on our Discord.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Release 0.8 - October[/b][/p][p]“Smoke me a kipper, I’ll be back for new content”[/p][p]New Cargo and Crew! The Sisters of Salvage faction joins the fight. 
Improved analytics tools (you won’t see these, but you’ll feel the impact of these in future balance updates). 
Leaderboard revision (more details soon) 
Database wipe! The wipe is everything. Your rank, battle records, XP, leaderboard presence, everything. We said we were going to do this sooner, but have had to move this to the October update. This will fix some important things, and will be the last time we ever do this. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Release 1.0 - November[/b][/p][p]“One small step for man, one giant leap for inventory management” [/p][p]November! This is it. And it’s a biggie. We’ll add to the game a brand new single player campaign that plays out quite differently to the current Warp Mode experience. We’ll talk about it more closer to the time. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Release 1.1 - December[/b][/p][p]No snappy theme for this one, and no new content. We just want to let you know that we’re going to be spending that time polishing, bug fixing, and giving us some space to respond to any feedback you might have on the new single player experience.[/p]

notes.title: 0.6.8377 Update - Bug Fixes
notes.notes: [p]Today's update fixes the 'dirty particles' issue that we have been seeing since launch. Overall, it wasn't impacting players often, but it was our most frequent issue, so we are delighted to have finally resolved it, especially as it was a bug inside Unreal Chaos, and not something we were directly responsible for. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45182011/9136eb5b7f148b3ede9fe9395c069097a858754f.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]To put it in context, over the last 90 days, this bug occurred 309 times - the next biggest issue occurred 26 times, and that was people trying to play the game with outdated graphics drivers, so hopefully this update has removed over 70% of our major errors. [/p][p][/p][p][u]Bug Fixes[/u][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that would cause the game to crash to desktop after a battle[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where rerolling could reduce the charges/duration of effects that didn't affect reroll chances[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an exploit related to YouSellAnySpaceship and Undo/Redo to get infinite credits[/p][/*][*][p]Re-balanced YouSellAnySpaceship.com to only trigger once per trader phase[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with StarScope affecting every item in the shop, instead of only discounting Common Spaceships[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for intermittent crash when loading an in-progress run[/p][p][/p][/*][/list]

- Your Carrier starts with all tiles unlocked.
- In the Trader, the first set of items each round are free, and rerolled items are half price!
- 5 wins required, only 3 lives. 

Just like Warp Mode, all successful runs will be entered into a tournament at the end of the event!

notes.title: Early Access Roadmap
notes.notes:
[u][b]Early Access Roadmap[/b][/u]

Welcome aboard Konfronto Early Access, Commander, we’re thrilled to have you join us. Let’s talk about what you can expect as we chart our course toward version 1.0

[u][b]Current Version[/b][/u]
Our Early Access launch is already packed full of content, with over 170 items available in the game, creating billions of possible combinations. Our core seasons have started, and they will be joined by time-limited one-off special events. At the end of each multiplayer season or event, grand tournaments give players a chance to fight it out to find the best builds and showcase who has really understood the meta. Based on these results, we'll also be adjusting the balance of content to ensure there are as many ways to win as possible. The cups you win are recorded forever, so the earlier you start, the more you can win and keep your spot on the all-time leaderboard!

Don’t forget, we're running a special competition for our first season of Warp Mode, where you can win a chance to design your very own Character for a future update. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2994150/view/515208812015125026?l=english]link[/url]


[u][b]Immediate Priority [/b][/u]
On top of balance passes between seasons, our primary focus following launch will be fixing bugs and improving performance as well as communicating with the community to find which features you really want!


[u][b]Next Major Update[/b][/u]
Our next major update will welcome a new faction of sentient plants to the sector, the Humanitarians. When first encountered, their moniker was believed to indicate a peaceful faction, but it was simply a statement of their preferred dietary requirements, causing some very unpleasant interactions with the first diplomats from Earth. They introduce a new Devour mechanic, letting you sacrifice and 'spare' Crew for permanent item buffs - a lovely bunch once you get to know them.

We will also be adding Simplified and Traditional Chinese to the localisation options. 

This update should drop around the start of June, but we will provide more information closer to the date.


[b][u]And Beyond…[/u][/b]
For future releases, we have a number of core tasks we want to release, such as Controller Support, an in-game Progression System and unlockable Achievements, as well as many more special game modes and modifiers. Join our Discord server and let us know what you want added to the game. We always work closely with the community on features and content, as we truly enjoy developing alongside our players and can’t wait to start sharing ideas with everyone.

notes.title: Aborted Launch
notes.notes:
We have been waiting for final approval from Steam but unfortunately, last night they failed the submission because we had 'Spanish - Spain', and 'Spanish - Latin America' listed on the store page, but we only had 'Spanish' in the game. A mistake from when we originally setup the store page and planned to support additional languages. 

We resubmitted almost immediately after we received the rejection but we have no way of knowing how long this process is going to take again. It could be another week before we get approval.

Given the importance of appearing on the 'upcoming' lists, we think it's best if we wait for approval and then set a release date for a day or two after that.

I know this will be frustrating for many of you waiting to start playing but you can only imagine how we feel. We lined up multiple sponsored streams to hit this original release date, and now we are stuck in limbo.

We will keep you posted on any updates.

notes.title: Konfronto Demo - Available Now!
notes.notes:
First and foremost: The demo for Konfronto is now live! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2994150/Konfronto/]Go try it! [/url]


But wait! The Mew Republick has a message to prepare you before you dirty your paws in combat:

Konfronto is an inventory management auto battler, what does that even mean? 

At the start of every game, you will be given a brand new Intergalactic Carrier with a randomised shape of tiles, there you will be able to fit the different Spaceships, Shield Generators and a crazy array of Tools and Pilots you can recruit from the Trader.

The Spaceships and other Cargo need to be placed on the free space you have in your Carrier, and the Crew can be used to Pilot and enhance your Spaceships or to clean free the blocked space on your Carrier to have more tiles on the next rounds!

Once you think you have the best Carrier a commander such as Duke Skyclawer could only dream of, join the Battle! And see your Carrier engage in asynchronous battles with other players all over the galaxy.

What does the Demo contain?

👾Over 50 Spaceships and other cargo to place in your Carrier
🎉Over 15 different Fusions to discover
🧑‍✈️Over 15 different Crew members to help you on the battlefield and pilot some of the craziest Spaceships you have seen in an inventory management sci-fi auto battler (call us if you see any other inventory management sci-fi auto battlers, thanks)

The placement of Cargo in your Carrier is very important! When you are dragging items to your carrier, make sure to check the squares and triangles that will light up when you place them next to other cargo that activates their effects.

Here is a Sneak peek of the different wacky factions you will encounter in Konfronto’s world:

😺The Mew Republick: A rebel bunch of cats from a galaxy far far away.  They have a wide array of common spaceships you will find early on. They specialise in destroying the shields of enemy carriers while having an assortment of secret tools under their hood, some even would say they have enough tools to destroy an empire.
If you manage to find some of their legendary artefacts don’t miss them or you will regret it!

🤖The Poultron Collective: These cyborg chickens have bad temper. They are chickens, they are also cyborgs, they lay eggs and will lay you to victory if you can trust them.
When using Poultrons your Spaceships and Generators will create Power Surge, a valuable resource that will enhance your Poultron Spaceships beyond the damage any other faction can offer you. And you will also have scrambled eggs for breakfast, which is always a good deal.

🧙‍♀️P.R.O.T.E.C.T.: Have you ever seen a wizard pilot a magic sword spaceship? The P.R.O.T.E.C.T. (Write it this way lest you incur the wrath of Barrowman the White watching through his Palantir) are a group of space wizards with some of the wackiest techno magic you will see in this universe (multiverse existence to be confirmed).
They specialise in generating Shields like no others, but beware, some of their spells that can turn those very shields into spells that will disintegrate your carrier’s hull before your very eyes.

The more observant amongst you may be able to catch a glimpse about some of the factions to come in the future:

🍔Just Fleet: The fastest Spaceships with the lowest paid pilots in the universe bringing defeat right to your door (please, leave them a tip)
🧟Deadshirts: These zombies seek out new life and new civilisations… and promptly kill them… Best avoid eh?

And many more crazy factions to come in the future!

Once you start familiarising yourself with the systems of Konfronto and get your first victories, you will see that after each run ends you will see your rank go up or down. 
The rank you gain is calculated based on how many wins you manage to achieve before your lives run out, so make sure to try to make the most out of each life to get more points!

Once you gather enough ranking points you will rank up, making you match against stronger starship commanders with even more fearsome carriers to battle and you’ll spot advanced strategies moments before your Carrier explodes!

Make sure to show us the best Space Carriers you can build by tagging us on social media or joining our discord where you can share strategies with other Space Commanders.

Good luck on the battlefield, you will need it, and now a message from our sponsors:

"In space, no one else can sell ice cream" - Just Fleet (c) promotional ad
